nodes.title: Leadership & Strategy
nodes.markdown:
## Cross-Functional Leadership

I operate at the intersection of strategy and delivery, with 7+ years across e-commerce and regulated financial services.

### Working with People
- **Team Leadership:** Currently leading a 6-person data engineering team, mentoring engineers and BI analysts.
- **Stakeholder Discovery:** Running discovery sessions with C-level executives, marketing, and operations to surface data opportunities and translate them into actionable platform roadmaps.
- **Executive Communication:** Distilling complex technical risk and revenue reconciliation into clear, executive-level summaries.

nodes.title: Database Reconstruction
nodes.markdown:
## Platform Modernization

Leading a company-wide initiative to reconstruct the data platform from fragmented, intuition-led legacy ETL to a trusted, self-service architecture.

### Architectural Highlights
- **Medallion Architecture:** Architecting a governed Bronze/Silver/Gold DWH on Amazon Redshift.
- **Unified Data Model:** Designed a unified customer-level gold data model integrating order, financial, and CRM data across multiple e-commerce brands into a single trusted decision layer.
- **Governance:** Implementing data contracts, schema governance, metric ownership, and active PII remediation.

nodes.title: AI & Automation
nodes.markdown:
## Democratizing Data via AI

I believe in opening up data systems to automation and AI so that teams can move faster.

### Initiatives
- **Self-Service AI Analytics:** Launched governed, natural-language-to-SQL analytics tools with per-team service accounts and documented schemas, empowering non-technical users to 'talk to their data'.
- **Engineering Automation:** Championing AI-assisted workflows in daily engineering, using Claude Code for codebase analysis and automated documentation to drastically speed up delivery pipelines.

nodes.title: Regulated Finance
nodes.markdown:
## Financial Services Analytics

Before e-commerce, I led data migration and integration in a regulated, publicly listed lending environment (AS DelfinGroup).

### Key Contributions
- **Predictive Scoring:** Built and deployed predictive models for leasing risk assessment.
- **Compliance & Security:** Led massive PII audits, ensuring compliance in highly regulated environments through credential vaulting and access control matrices.
- **Financial Analytics:** Engineered enterprise Power BI dashboards with complex DAX logic for high-value operational and financial reporting.

nodes.title: Core Tech Stack
nodes.markdown:
## Technology Ecosystem

A strategic approach to technology evaluation and implementation.

- **Cloud & DWH:** Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL, Snowflake evaluation, AWS S3
- **Orchestration & Engineering:** Apache Airflow, Python, Advanced SQL, Docker, Git
- **Analytics & BI:** Enterprise Power BI (Semantic models, DAX, XMLA), CLV/LTV Modeling with XGBoost
- **Advisory:** Structured vendor evaluations for CDP and Cloud Data Platforms.
